snippet.title: Madness at the Darkmoon Faire Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Come one, come all to the Darkmoon Faire, Azeroth’s one and only traveling carnival! Ignore the rumors about our warm and caring faire-folk! Pay them no heed! Come for the wholesome fun and stay. . . forever. Madness at the Darkmoon Faire will launch worldwide on November 17 with 135 new collectible cards, the new Corrupt keyword, ancient artifacts, and so much more!

• Learn more about Madness at the Darkmoon Faire: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23533210
• Check out the all-new game mode, Hearthstone Duels: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23529213
• See what’s changing with the Progression & Rewards Revamp: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23534414
• Read the 18.6 Patch Notes: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23534413

Download Hearthstone: https://blizz.ly/34Ggx3A
